data.title: Bitcoin community recognizes the quantum risk, says VanEck's Matthew Sigel
data.description: Matthew Sigel, VanEck's head of digital assets research, talks about the electricity value chain as the key investment link between bitcoin and AI. He also notes that quantum computing poses a risk to crypto, but adds that the bitcoin community is developing a framework for quantum-resistant upgrades.
